comparison.objective: Place a phone, watch, and earbuds case on their matching positions of a three-device charger and leave all charging.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-object contact/alignment, magnetic placement, flexible watch-band handling, and indicator visibility management.
comparison.success_condition: Each released device charges uninterrupted for five seconds with a visible indicator while the stand remains within 5 mm and 5° of its starting pose.
comparison.reason: It tests repeated device placement and charging confirmation rather than coupled screw/nut manipulation or retaining an adjusted mechanical stop.
